tasks.description: Add a light/dark theme toggle control in the application's Settings page. The toggle should immediately switch the active theme. This control should be intuitive and follow the existing design tokens.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user is on the Settings page, when the theme toggle is clicked, then the active theme switches immediately.

tasks.description: Persist the user's selected theme to localStorage so the same theme is applied automatically on the user's next visit. Ensure the data is stored securely and efficiently.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user selects a theme, when the user closes and reopens the application, then the previously selected theme is applied.

tasks.description: On the first load, when the user has no stored preference, honor the operating system setting via the prefers-color-scheme media query to choose the initial theme. Ensure this works across different operating systems.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user has no stored theme preference, when the application is loaded, then the theme matches the operating system's preferred color scheme.

tasks.description: Apply the active theme consistently to all pages and shared components of the application. Ensure the theme is applied without affecting the application's functionality.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user selects a theme, when the user navigates through the application, then the selected theme is consistently applied across all pages and components.

tasks.description: Thoroughly test the theme toggle functionality to ensure it works as expected across different scenarios and devices. This includes testing persistence, system preference respect, and global application.
acceptance_criteria: Given various test scenarios, when the theme toggle is tested, then the theme toggle functions correctly and as expected in all scenarios.
